description: This file defines the interface IEventHandler with pure virtual functions for handling OCI container events, such as start, stop, failure, and state change, within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling OCI container related events, requiring implementation of event handling methods.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Handles events when an OCI container starts.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Handles events when an OCI container stops.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Handles events when an OCI container encounters a failure.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles events when an OCI container's state changes.
